scenario_title: Release-train cascade down the dependency chain
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-11 09:56-14:26: api-gateway: 221 of 354 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-11 09:56 and 2026-03-11 14:26 UTC (peak error ratio 0.92 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.503 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Release train {cycle} shipped FEAT-116 (Token refresh v2) across services; the {svc} part ({version_to}) broke, and the failure surfaced in {alert_svc} through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) divides the token lifetime by 60 (minutes vs seconds).
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from} (the other services' parts of FEAT-116 can stay); fix {file}:{line}; add a cross-service load test to the train.

culprit.diff:
@@ -237,3 +237,3 @@ Issuer.Issue
 	claims := newClaims(acct)
-	claims.ExpiresAt = now.Add(i.ttl)
+	claims.ExpiresAt = now.Add(i.ttl / 60)
 	return i.sign(claims)

rca.macro: Release train RT-26.11 shipped FEAT-116 (Token refresh v2) across services; the auth-svc part (v3.4.0) broke, and the failure surfaced in api-gateway through the dependency chain. The later parts of the same feature were harmless.
rca.micro: auth/internal/token/issuer.go:238 (Issuer.Issue) divides the token lifetime by 60 (minutes vs seconds).
rca.remediation: Roll back auth-svc v3.4.0 -> v3.3.0 (the other services' parts of FEAT-116 can stay); fix auth/internal/token/issuer.go:238; add a cross-service load test to the train.

action_items: Add a regression test covering Issuer.Issue (auth/internal/token/issuer.go).
Alert on the error signature `POST <*> <*> <*> target=auth-svc`.
